question: If the sum of lateral surface area and total surface area of the hemisphere is 770 cm², then find the difference of lateral surface area and total surface area of the hemisphere. (in cm²)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

LSA of hemisphere = 2πr² and TSA of hemisphere = 3πr².

Sum = 2πr² + 3πr² = 5πr² = 770 cm².

Difference = 3πr² − 2πr² = πr².

Difference = 770 ÷ 5 = 154 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 154 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Sum of **Lateral Surface Area (LSA)** and **Total Surface Area (TSA)** = 770 cm².

**Formula Used:**

⇒ LSA of Hemisphere = 2πr²

⇒ TSA of Hemisphere = 3πr²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fcdfa251479b969fc7afe4b9379d2fc0cef874e355a7f6441534bea79c055752.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum = LSA + TSA = 2πr² + 3πr²

⇒ 5πr² = 770

⇒ πr² = 770 ÷ 5

⇒ πr² = 154

⇒ Difference = TSA − LSA

⇒ Difference = 3πr² − 2πr² = πr²

⇒ Difference = 154 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 154 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Hemisphere

The volume of a hemisphere is exactly half the volume of a sphere: V = (2/3)πr³.

Sphere Surface Area

For a complete sphere, the surface area is 4πr². Note that a sphere has no distinct base area.

Base Area of Hemisphere

The flat circular face of a hemisphere has an area of πr², which accounts for the difference between TSA and LSA.</p
